s1-loss.text: After chemotherapy, Renita lost her hair.

s2-stranger.text: When she looked in the mirror, she saw a stranger.

s3-christmas.text: Then, on Christmas Day, she put on a wig, drew on her brows, and sat down with her family.

s4-herself.text: For a few hours, she felt like herself again.

s5-fast.text: In one study, it began just eighteen days after treatment started.

s6-question.text: What if every woman could find that feeling, before her hair is gone?

s7-bloom.text: Bloom lets you try real wigs, wraps, brows and lashes on your own face, before treatment begins.

w1-passport.text: She takes one photo, and Bloom makes her Hair Passport.

w2-reading.text: Her hair colour is measured right on her phone.
YouCam's AI reads her face, her brows and her hair length.
Her hair is saved, even after it's gone.

w3-tryon.text: In the fitting room, Bloom finds real wigs that match her hair.
One tap, and YouCam's AI puts that wig on her own face.

w4-check.text: She can compare it with her own hair.
Bloom even measures the colour on the finished image.

w5-new.text: Many wigs can't be returned once opened.
Here, she can try as many as she likes.

w6-layers.text: And because chemo can take brows and lashes, she can layer them right on top of her wig.

w7-guide.text: The Bloom guide is an AI agent.
It searches real products, checks the fit, and explains every pick.

w8-together.text: She sends her favourites to the people she loves, and they vote.

w9-decision.text: When she's ready, Bloom opens that exact product at the store, with notes to help her ask her insurer to cover it.

c4-still.text: Hair loss can make the mirror feel like a stranger.
Bloom helps her look in, and say: this is still me.

c2-apis.text: Six YouCam APIs, working live, in one complete journey.
A real problem, solved before hair loss begins.

c3-team.text: Bloom is led by a woman.
Nourin Richi found the problem, and designed the answer.
With Ahammad Shawki, two university students turned it into a working product.

c4a-look.text: Bloom helps her look in the mirror, and say:

c4-stranger.text: Hair loss can make the mirror feel like a stranger.
